image_description: A close-up shot of two stacked ceramic teacups on a patterned saucer. The bottom cup is larger with a floral/fruit motif (possibly pomegranate or orange) and a red rim. The top cup is smaller, filled with a brownish liquid (likely tea or coffee), and features a delicate floral pattern. In the background, there are blurred wine glasses and wooden furniture. The scene appears to be a domestic table setting.
